preconditions.description: The size of the set S is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= 10**6 for s_i in S)
preconditions.description: Each element in the set S is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i] < S[i+1] for i in range(len(S)-1))
preconditions.description: The elements of the set S are in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(sequence) <= 4000 and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in sequence))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a sequence of integers where each integer is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive and the length of the sequence does not exceed 4000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or set(gcd(a_i, a_j) for i in range(len(sequence)) for j in range(i, len(sequence))) == set(S)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the set of all gcd values of subarrays of the sequence must be equal to the set S.
